The GESI Risk Allocator favours being underweight risk assets given the distribution of stresses within the GFSI. The percentages of Bullish, Bearish and Neutral GFSI components (as used in the Risk Allocator) were 8.7%, 13.0% & 78.3%, respectively as of 5-Aug. The Risk Allocator (using Bull, Bear & Neutral weights of 2, 0, 1) suggests
reducing the underweight position to 4.3% UW from last week's 17.4% UW.
